versions.changelog:
global-intel-summary v3.3.0 introduces a major upgrade focused on real-time, structured global intelligence and news reporting.

- Integrated 30+ high-quality RSS sources across politics, tech, finance, government, defense, and regional news.
- Added an automated "Alert System" for classifying major geopolitical events (war, sanctions, military, etc.).
- Enabled cross-news correlation detection and narrative evolution tracking.
- Auto-tags news with relevant global regions (Europe, MENA, APAC, Americas, Africa).
- Enforces strict data timeliness (24h freshness) and source attribution for every data point.
- Enhanced financial/market tracking with mandatory authoritative sources for crypto, US, and China/HK stocks.
- New structured report templates and intelligence escalation rules for clear, actionable summaries.
